title: Dutch Spiced Breakfast Cake (Ontbijtkoek)
hookLine: Netherlands-inspired dutch spiced breakfast cake (ontbijtkoek) with 8 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Preheat & Prep Your Pan
steps.instructionTemplate: Preheat the oven to 160˚C (320˚F) Line a cake pan with parchment paper and set aside. Line your baking pan with parchment paper or grease lightly, and make sure {m53387_1}, {m53387_2}, {m53387_3}, and {m53387_4} are measured and at room temperature so they blend smoothly.
steps.activeMeasureSummary: Self-raising Flour, Dark Brown Soft Sugar
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure self-raising flour first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Sift & Whisk Dry Ingredients
steps.instructionTemplate: Mix all the dry ingredients together in a large bowl. Place the milk in a small saucepan and heat it until it is almost boiling but not quite. Incorporate {m53387_5}, {m53387_6}, {m53387_7}, and {m53387_8} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Sift & Whisk Dry Ingredients
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour the milk slowly into the dry ingredients while whisking. Don't overmix! As soon as it is combined to a smooth batter you pour it into the cake pan. Sprinkle the pearl sugar over the top and bake it in the oven for about 1 hour.

steps.title: Cool, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Check after about 50 minutes how the cake is progressing. If a cake tester comes out clean the cake it cooked. If not let it cook for a little longer.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Wait until the sponge feels cool to the touch before frosting so your glaze or cream stays thick and glossy.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 45 mins!
